side_notes: Under-coverage: all three agents operated almost exclusively at the sentence/clause/word level (em-dashes, diction, nominalizations, embedded statistics, intra-sentence restatement). Paragraph-level architecture went unexamined -- no finding addresses the ordering of units U1-U7, inter-paragraph transitions, or whether the complexity gap is concentrated in particular paragraphs versus distributed uniformly.

Under-coverage: figurative language is thinly sampled. Only one finding (a1-f9, kept) flags metaphor ('different clocks', 'cell ... leave empty'); a systematic pass for other figurative/imagery-based constructions across the section was not performed by any agent.

Guardrail note for the human: the kept/canonical set retains every guardrail_collision=true observation (a1-f2, a1-f8, a2-f4, a3-f4, a3-f6, a3-f9, a3-f10). Several sit on load-bearing hedges -- necessity-only ('does not claim the residual is that signal'), no-novelty/positioning-not-mechanism ('positioning claim ... not a tested mechanism'), and the descriptive-not-causal scope. These are style-of-phrasing flags only; any edit here must preserve the hedge's meaning.
